text:
marta (sre): opening follow-up thread — customers reported intermittent TLS handshake errors for cross-region requests (us-east -> eu-central) during morning deploy window. noticed increase in conn resets and 502s at 08:12 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy event: rollout config-v2.14 -> 08:06 UTC -> services: egress-proxy, route-manager

kevin (networking): seeing bursts of SYN/FIN pairs through egress NATs, some flows appear to get rehomed mid-handshake. this smells like ephemeral port reuse + asymmetric path.

li (eng-runtime): stack traces show TLS alert 40 and occasional cert CN mismatch logged where SNI present. attaching sample log snippet.

marta (sre): minimal repro steps for infra: spin a test pod in us-east and run:
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -H "Host: api.redwood.internal" https://api.redwood.internal/health || echo "fail:$i"; done
```

kevin (networking): immediate mitigation M1: throttle cross-region connection churn on egress-nat (rate-limit ephemeral port churn) in us-east for 2h. owner: kevin. ETA: 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC.

li (eng-runtime): mitigation M2: enable stricter LB session stickiness for cross-region routed connections to avoid mid-handshake LB hops. owner: li. ETA: 2026-03-18 09:30 UTC.

marta (sre): action A1: collect targeted tcpdump on egress-nat-01 and route-manager logs for window 08:00-08:20 UTC. owner: marta. ETA: 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC.

nate (cloud-eng): action A2: open cloud provider support case for NAT gateway port exhaustion and ask for debug traces for AS-path and health-check timing. owner: nate. ETA: 2026-03-20 17:00 UTC.

emma (product): action A3: draft customer-facing note and support-runbook entry highlighting temporary mitigations and recommended retry backoffs. owner: emma (product). ETA: 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC.

support-bot: create ticket: SUP-4521 for impacted tenants. linked to this thread.

li (eng-runtime): observation: KV-cache cold misses during the rollout increased tail latency for handshake completion by ~35ms which widened race windows. filing follow-up with Optimize.

kevin (networking): discovered a rare cert rotation race on lb-eu-central-1 where new certs were partially rolled before routing updates completed. that can produce short windows where SNI hits an instance without the right cert chain.

marta (sre): action A4: add TLS handshake telemetry (SNI, cert_serial, route_instance_id, conn_id) to route-manager logs for 7 days. owner: marta. ETA: 2026-03-19 07:00 UTC.

li (eng-runtime): short-term rollback plan if errors spike: revert stickiness change or apply per-tenant routing to keep impacted customers in-region. will prepare playbook. owner: li. ETA: 2026-03-18 11:00 UTC.

emma (product): customer impact snapshot: 4 enterprise customers saw elevated 5xx for ~18m each, automated retry increased request latencies. include this in postmortem.

marta (sre): scheduled sync: 2026-03-18 14:00 UTC to review pcaps and provider response. please upload captures and PR links here.

deploy-bot: rollout status: stickiness flag -> rolled to 100% at 08:40 UTC (auto).

kevin (networking): uploaded filtered pcap (08:06:00-08:20:00) and extracted trace where same client IP hit two different backend cert CNs within 30s. link in thread.

nate (cloud-eng): provider case opened: CASE-8342999, awaiting AS-path logs and NAT gateway counters. will paste provider response when available.

li (eng-runtime): will follow up with PR links for config changes: github.com/redwood/route-manager/pull/423 and infra PR for throttle.

marta (sre): marking owners/ETAs here as canonical. please ping me for any blockers. this will be added to the formal postmortem follow-up list and tracked until A1-A4 closed. :white_check_mark:

emma (product): thanks everyone. once RCA is confirmed, we'll schedule a short customer postmortem and remediation timeline.

support-bot: SUP-4521 status -> triage (updated 2026-03-18 10:05 UTC)
